id: \bHello! Sorry to keep you waiting!
en: \bHello! Sorry to keep you waiting!
it: \bCiao! Scusa se ti ho fatto aspettare!

id: \bWelcome to the world of Pokémon.
en: \bWelcome to the world of Pokémon.
it: \bBenvenuto nel mondo dei Pokémon.

id: \bMy name is Professor Oak.
en: \bMy name is Professor Oak.
it: \bMi chiamo Professor Oak.

id: \bPeople call me the Pokémon Professor.
en: \bPeople call me the Pokémon Professor.
it: \bLa gente mi chiama il Professore dei Pokémon.

id: \bIf you need help, I am certainly capable of giving it.
en: \bIf you need help, I am certainly capable of giving it.
it: \bSe hai bisogno di aiuto, sono senz'altro in grado di dartelo.

id: \bWell then, without further ado...
en: \bWell then, without further ado...
it: \bBene, allora, senza ulteriori indugi...

id: <ac>\c[0]\l[3]You are about to enter a world\nwhere you will embark on a grand\nadventure of your very own.
en: <ac>\c[0]\l[3]You are about to enter a world\nwhere you will embark on a grand\nadventure of your very own.
it: <ac>\c[0]\l[3]Stai per entrare in un mondo\nin cui intraprenderai una grande\navventura tutta tua.

id:
<ac>\c[0]\l[5]Speak to people and check things
 wherever you go, be it in towns,
roads or caves.
 Gather information and hints from
 every possible source.
en:
<ac>\c[0]\l[5]Speak to people and check things
 wherever you go, be it in towns,
roads or caves.
 Gather information and hints from
 every possible source.
it:
<ac>\c[0]\l[5]Parla con le persone ed esamina ogni cosa
 ovunque tu vada, che sia in città,
lungo le strade o nelle grotte.
 Raccogli informazioni e indizi da
 ogni fonte possibile.

id: <ac>\c[0]\l[3]New paths will open to you when\n you help people in need, overcome\n challenges, and solve mysteries.
en: <ac>\c[0]\l[3]New paths will open to you when\n you help people in need, overcome\n challenges, and solve mysteries.
it: <ac>\c[0]\l[3]Nuove strade ti si apriranno quando\n aiuterai chi è in difficoltà, supererai\n sfide e risolverai misteri.

id:
<ac>\c[0]\l[7]At times, you will be challenged
 by others to a battle.
 At other times, wild creatures
may stand in your way.

 By overcoming such hurdles,
you will gain great power.
en:
<ac>\c[0]\l[7]At times, you will be challenged
 by others to a battle.
 At other times, wild creatures
may stand in your way.

 By overcoming such hurdles,
you will gain great power.
it:
<ac>\c[0]\l[7]A volte, altri ti sfideranno
 a una lotta.
 Altre volte, creature selvatiche
potrebbero sbarrarti la strada.

 Superando questi ostacoli,
acquisirai un grande potere.

id: <ac>\c[0]\l[2]However, your adventure is not\n solely about becoming powerful.
en: <ac>\c[0]\l[2]However, your adventure is not\n solely about becoming powerful.
it: <ac>\c[0]\l[2]Tuttavia, la tua avventura non consiste\n soltanto nel diventare forte.

id:
<ac>\c[0]\l[7]On your travels, we hope that
 you will meet countless people
 and, through them, achieve
personal growth.

 This is the most important
objective of this adventure.
en:
<ac>\c[0]\l[7]On your travels, we hope that
 you will meet countless people
 and, through them, achieve
personal growth.

 This is the most important

it:
<ac>\c[0]\l[7]Durante i tuoi viaggi, speriamo che
 incontrerai innumerevoli persone
 e che, grazie a loro, potrai
crescere come persona.

 Questo è l'obiettivo più importante
di questa avventura.

id: \bThis world is inhabited by creatures we call Pokémon.
en: \bThis world is inhabited by creatures we call Pokémon.
it: \bQuesto mondo è abitato da creature chiamate Pokémon.

id: \bPeople and Pokémon live together by supporting each other.
en: \bPeople and Pokémon live together by supporting each other.
it: \bPersone e Pokémon vivono insieme, sostenendosi a vicenda.

id: \bSome people play with Pokémon, some battle with them.
en: \bSome people play with Pokémon, some battle with them.
it: \bAlcuni giocano con i Pokémon, altri ci lottano insieme.

id: \bBut we don't know everything about Pokémon yet.
en: \bBut we don't know everything about Pokémon yet.
it: \bMa non sappiamo ancora tutto sui Pokémon.

id: \bThere are still many mysteries to solve.
en: \bThere are still many mysteries to solve.
it: \bCi sono ancora tanti misteri da risolvere.

id: \bThat's why I study Pokémon every day.
en: \bThat's why I study Pokémon every day.
it: \bEcco perché studio i Pokémon ogni giorno.

id: \bAre you a boy or a girl?
en: \bAre you a boy or a girl?
it: \bSei un ragazzo o una ragazza?

id: \bNow what did you say your name was?
en: \bNow what did you say your name was?
it: \bCome hai detto che ti chiami?

id: \bSo you're \PN?
en: \bSo you're \PN?
it: \bQuindi sei \PN?

id: \bWhat is your name?
en: \bWhat is your name?
it: \bCome ti chiami?

id: \b\PN, are you ready?
en: \b\PN, are you ready?
it: \b\PN, sei pronto?

id: \bYour very own Pokémon story is about to unfold.
en: \bYour very own Pokémon story is about to unfold.
it: \bLa tua storia Pokémon sta per avere inizio.

id: \bYou'll face fun times and tough challenges.
en: \bYou'll face fun times and tough challenges.
it: \bTi aspettano momenti divertenti e sfide difficili.

id: \bA world of dreams and adventures with Pokémon awaits! Let's go!
en: \bA world of dreams and adventures with Pokémon awaits!  Let's go!
it: \bUn mondo di sogni e avventure con i Pokémon ti attende!  Andiamo!
